title: Nonnegative perfect derived charts for a proper flat direct image
statement: Choose derived categories of scheme module categories and their open over-sites in one universe [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S be flat, proper and locally finitely presented, and F finite locally free [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. For s∈U⊆S there are s∈V⊆U, K∈D(O_V), b∈Z such that K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] and H^i(K tensor^L M)=0 for every module M if i<0 or b<i [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. For every a:T→V there is an isomorphism H^0(L a* K) ≅ p_* q* F, with p:X×_S T→T and q:X×_S T→X and tensor pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-module-pullback]. There is no reference bundle or rank predicate.

proof.text: Reuse Modules.isFlatOver_of_isFiniteLocallyFree from PerfectCohomologyFromGeometric (import all exposes its private theorem) to make F flat relative to S. Choose an affine neighbourhood V of s inside U, and apply exists_proper_flat_affine_cech_perfect_model to obtain D bounded in [0,d], flat termwise over the identity, perfect Q(D), and its cohomology comparisons after arbitrary ordinary pullback. Take K=Q(D), b=d.

Apply isFlat_of_affineFlatOver_identity to every term and isKFlat_of_boundedAbove_flat_ringedSpace to D. For a module M, mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso identifies D tensor M[0] with the complex of termwise tensors. Terms outside [0,d] vanish since additive tensor functors preserve zero objects. Zero middle term implies zero homology; D with its identity representation witnesses the derived-tensor vanishing. The tensorClosed theorem supplies the monoidal preadditive instance.

For a:T→V unpack derivedPullback_spec from the adopted source DerivedPullback module and identify its additive module functor with tensorPullback by functor extensionality. Its counit is invertible on the K-flat D. The quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors isomorphisms give L a* Q(D) ≅ Q(a_tensor*D). Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor pullback with ordinary pullback. Apply homologyFunctorFactors in degree zero, followed by the Cech comparison for the standard pullback square. The rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf of pushforward and the ordinary-to-tensor pullback isomorphism on F give the desired ordinary direct image.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_properFlatDirectImagePerfectChart
    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (U : T.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings T.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (U : S.Opens) (s : S) (hs : s ∈ U) :
    ∃ V : S.Opens, s ∈ V ∧ V ≤ U ∧
      ∃ (K : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme) (b : ℤ),
        IsPerfect V.toScheme K ∧
        (∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace),
          ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ b < i →
            schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes V.toScheme K M i) ∧
        ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (a : T ⟶ V.toScheme),
          Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((derivedPullback a).obj K)) ≅
            ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (a ≫ V.ι))).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (a ≫ V.ι))).obj F)))
